name: com.mayamystic.apiframework
description: Enterprise-grade middleware-based API networking framework for Unity. Provides a modular middleware pipeline with authentication injection, retry strategies, request logging, token providers, endpoint resolvers, and flexible request body handling including JSON, multipart, and form-urlencoded requests.

samples.description: Demonstrates ApiManager setup, middleware registration, logging, retry handling, and executing API requests.
Demonstrates login API flow using ApiHandlerBase, endpoint resolvers, token providers, and form-urlencoded requests.
Demonstrates smart retry middleware with exponential backoff and retry logging.
Demonstrates multipart/form-data requests including file uploads and form fields.
